nodes.name: Reduce To Closed Codes
nodes.notes: Copies no text from the failure: closed lists and strict ID shapes only.

parameters.content:
# START HERE: EnergyGrid monitor error log

- **When:** n8n starts this workflow itself when a production run of `EnergyGrid - Local Run Monitor` fails (its `settings.errorWorkflow` points here). Manual runs of the monitor never call it. Running this workflow by hand in the editor feeds n8n's fixed Error Trigger sample (workflow `1`, execution `231`, mode `manual`); that sample writes **no row** (#288, 22 Nov 2026), so an editor test never shows as a failed run in the health email.
- **Why (#288 option (c), owner 20 Nov 2026):** the monitor saves no failed executions, because a rejected webhook report would keep the valid `X-EnergyGrid-Monitor-Key` token in n8n's execution data. n8n 2.48.5 still calls the error workflow before it drops an unsaved failed run.
- **Flow:** `Monitor Run Failed` (Error Trigger) -> `Reduce To Closed Codes` -> `Record Failure Row`: one row in the Data Table `energygrid_monitor_error_log`.
- **Row:** `workflow_id`, `execution_id`, `failed_node`, `code`, `mode`, `failed_at`. `code` is one of the monitor's own `EG_MONITOR_*` codes (message = the code, alone or with n8n's exact ` [line N]` suffix), `EG_MONITOR_TRIGGER_FAILED`, or `EG_MONITOR_UNCLASSIFIED`. No message text, no item data, no headers.
- **Reader:** `XB Daily Health` counts every row of the last 24 h (WARN `error_runs`; the table is the monitor's alone), checks that this workflow is active, and checks that the monitor still points here.
- **Failures:** nothing of this workflow is saved either (its input can hold item data). If it breaks, the daily health check shows the table read failing or this workflow inactive.
- Do not add Gmail, HTTP Request, Execute Command, file, Telegram or AI nodes. Do not copy `execution.error` fields into the row.

# Setup (local import copy only)

- Import inactive, into the **same n8n project** as the Data Table and `EnergyGrid - Local Run Monitor` (caller policy `workflowsFromSameOwner`). Create the Data Table first; the monitor's error workflow must be **published** (n8n refuses an unpublished target).

## Required manual configuration:

- **Record Failure Row**
  - `Data table`: replace `REPLACE_WITH_MONITOR_ERROR_LOG_TABLE_ID` with the ID of `energygrid_monitor_error_log` (six `string` columns: `workflow_id`, `execution_id`, `failed_node`, `code`, `mode`, `failed_at`).
- **EnergyGrid - Local Run Monitor** (the other workflow)
  - `Settings > Error workflow`: this workflow (export placeholder `REPLACE_WITH_ENERGYGRID_MONITOR_ERROR_LOG_WORKFLOW_ID`).

No credentials. Rows are kept until removed by hand (a few per failure; see the monitor README).
